therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Retention of tumor suppressor proteins in nucleus to induce apoptosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by Independent Review Committee

safety_signals: Grade ≥2 peripheral neuropathy: 41/195 SVd vs 70/204 Vd (OR 0.5042, p=0.0013)
Serious adverse events: anemia, thrombocytopenia, febrile neutropenia, atrial fibrillation, cardiac events
results.dose_information: Selinexor 100 mg oral, Bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 subcutaneous, Dexamethasone 20 mg oral

context.duration: Up to 33 months treatment, up to 45 months follow-up
